posts.subject: Classleads 2017 q2: batch 1
posts.message:
We're pleased to bring you the first batch of classleads from the q2 2017 round. We'll be moving to this board from now on for classlead changes, to keep everything in the same place to reduce the need to scour the announce board for that one elusive change that happened months ago. Here are all the details:

Curses
------
* Having the SWIFTCURSE defence active will no longer negatively impact the damage of regular curse against denizens.
* The TZANTZA calculation now only starts reducing the time when the target has more than one tzantza affliction - this means for practical purposes the requirements have increased by one affliction.

Devotion
--------
* DAMNATION no longer bypasses the shield defence.

Domination
----------
* The GOLGOTHA'S GRACE defence will no longer be active when in dragonform.

Dragoncraft
-----------
* Added STUPIDITY and RECKLESSNESS as afflictions useable via DRAGONCURSE.

Gathering
---------
* The chance for EGGS and MILK is now equal.

Metamorphosis
-------------
* Many of the hydra abilities that did not generate kai now do and also hit deliverance.

Pranks
------
* You may no longer set the TIMERS on bombs while prone.

Reclamation
-----------
* EMBRACE now requires your room be reclaimed by you - being adjacent to a reclaimed room is no longer sufficient.

Runelore
--------
* Significantly reduced the willpower cost of EMPOWERing runic items.

Shadowmancy
-----------
* MANIFESTED CLOAKS may now be made nondecay through the customisation system.
* STRIKE now requires you to append KNEEL or PRONE to the command to gain the proning functionality. If you strike without the prone modifier against an unshielded opponent, they will not be proned and the balance lost you'll suffer will be reduced.
* The PARASITE affliction now extends the SPEED defence raising time by 2 seconds.

Shindo
------
* There is now a line on the look output showing whether someone has the AUGMENT defence active.

Survival
--------
* CLOTs willpower cost has been reduced.

Tarot
-----
* AGORAPHOBIA and CLAUSTROPHOBIA have been added to the list of afflictions deliverable with MOON tarot. Note that this only applies to the list of afflictions specifiable, they are not in the pool of afflictions that may be given randomly.

Tekura
------
* BEAR STANCE now only functions against targets at the same elevation as you.

Terminus
--------
* Serverside curing should now correctly respect various balances when attempting to put up terminus defences.
* Significantly reduced the cooldown on using LAIAD.

Twoarts
-------
* INFUSE ICE damage vs frozen targets has been reduced.
* There is now a message to the blademaster when an ice-infused sword attack strikes a frozen opponent.
* All sword attacks should now only require one arm to be unbroken to perform.
* DISCERN may no longer be used when paralysed.

Misc
----
* The class balance and class resource prompt settings will now show Terminus balance status and amount of Aeonics age respectively when in the Depthswalker class.
* You may no longer manually fill vials from your rift if prone or if you have two broken arms. The automatic refill that occurs when you use up the last sip/application in a vial will still occur.
* The AMNESIA ticks from the CONCUSSION affliction are now masked if the concussion is masked (so will not show up on affliction messages or gmcp). If the concussion is unmasked (i.e. from DIAGNOSEing or PREDICTing), the amnesia ticks will also be unmasked.
* Loyal (alive) mobiles such as minipets, mounts, and artefact pets will no longer fall out of your inventory upon death/quitting/etc.
* SOULFIRE CRUCIBLES will now go out on starbursts caused by themselves firing as well as starbursts caused by external sources.

Enjoy!

Penned by My hand on the 15th of Mayan, in the year 739 AF.

posts.subject: Classleads 2017 q2: batch 2
posts.message:
We're pleased to bring you the second batch of classleads from the 2017 q2 round. There are some fairly major ones in this batch, so we'll be closely monitoring these going forward. Here are the details:

Apostasy
--------
* The DAEMONITE entity now knocks off balance for longer when it attacks.

Artifice
--------
* DESTABILISE HEAT will now do twice as much damage against a target who is already ablaze.
* There is now a line on LOOK/QUICKLOOK for when an inferno is in a location.

Curses
------
* Curses that miss due to CLUMSINESS will now still generate JINX charges.
* The chance for curses to miss due to CLUMSINESS has been reduced to be in line with EVILEYE.
* INFLAME is now entirely percentile based rather than being a flat multiplier of target's current bleeding.

Formulation
-----------
* VAPOURISATION will now melt a random icewall if one is present when thrown at the ground. Note that this will only take place if one of its other effects do not - melting frozen ground and removing flood will always take priority.

Pranks
------
* The clouds produced by SMOKEBOMBS now function correctly.

Skirmishing
-----------
* WRENCH now does more damage based on the target's bleeding. This only takes affect once the target is bleeding 100 or more.

Weaponmastery
-------------
* (Sword and Board): FEROCITY is no longer a static decay value - it is now based on the balance time of the attack used that generated it. This should fix issues where balance times were longer than the ferocity decay timer.

Misc
----
* Consecutive arrows in a small window will now do progressively less damage. This is highly experimental.
* There is now a five second cooldown on CLUMSINESS firing. This is also experimental. This required us to move clumsiness handling onto a new system, so if you notice anything strange (such as certain attacks not being influenced by the cooldown), please bug it or message me.
* All forms of targeted corpse-based resurrection now share a 2 minute cooldown. This is on the target, not on the person doing the resurrecting.

Enjoy!

Penned by My hand on the 21st of Miraman, in the year 740 AF.

posts.subject: Classleads q2 2017: batch 3
posts.message:

Curses
------
* INFLAME has had its damage formula adjusted after the previous change - it was scaling too aggressively.

Dragoncraft
-----------

Pranks
------
* The periodic tick of ITCHPOWDER now more consistently takes place.
* You can no longer deliver timed bombs to pets by means of THROW TO.


Seafaring
---------
* SHIP WEAPON STATUS has been reformatted.
* SHIP EQUIPMENT has been added. This will display ship equipment and artefacts present on the ship, and which room they are located in.
* The victim of a PLUNDER will now see a log of this plundering on the ship's SHIPLOG. This will only state the plundering happened, not what or how much was lost.

Shadowmancy
-----------
* REAP and CULL damage now scale off of strength against denizens.

Tarot
-----
* You will now see the location that someone TOUCHes upon a UNIVERSE map.

Twoarts
-------
* POMMELSTRIKE no longer extends VOIDFIST duration.

Weaponmastery
-------------
* (Two handed): Made some minor adjustments to the damage formula - this should mostly only affect people at the very low end of health.

We'll be closely monitoring these in the coming days, and making further changes as necessary.

Enjoy!

Penned by My hand on the 24th of Miraman, in the year 742 AF.

posts.subject: Some Shikudo adjustments
posts.message:

- RUKO will now give both of its afflictions when performed in a kata chain of six or more actions.

- LIVESTRIKE performed against a stunned opponent now has a (fairly low) chance of delivering blackout.

I'll be closely monitoring these over the next week and making more adjustments as appropriate.

Penned by My hand on the 2nd of Scarlatan, in the year 743 AF.

posts.subject: Combat adjustments
posts.message:
I've just loaded up some combat adjustments. Here are the details:

Formulation
-----------
* You may now ADMINISTER NUTRITIONAL to other adventurers.
* Highly VOLATILE PETRIFYING compounds now convey a version of the IRONFORM defence that expires after five minutes. Low volatility versions of the compound continue to convey a version of the defence that lasts indefinitely.

Spiritlore
----------
* ARAYAN now has a 1 minute cooldown. I am considering further adjustments here, but the chain resurrection is the problem this change aims to solve.

Twoarts
-------
* A STRIKING STRIKE must come somewhat soon after a Two Arts slash. It can no longer come right before you would regain balance.

Voicecraft
----------
* MAQAM will now give DIZZINESS if the target already has clumsiness when you SING it at them.

Misc
----
* The DECAY font power has had its cost reduced.
* New font power: SENSE. Shows the locations of everyone in the city and their association to the city (citizen, enemy, neutral). Bypasses most forms of hiding, but does not bypass incorporeal status (blackwind, astralform, phase, and spiritwalk). This -does- bypass VEILED status.

Enjoy!

Penned by My hand on the 15th of Chronos, in the year 746 AF.

Enjoy!

posts.subject: Classleads 2017 q4: batch 1
posts.message:
With only a few more decisions to make on the classleads for the final quarter of 2017, we've just loaded up the first batch of finalised reports. Here are the details:

Aeonics
-------
* BOOSTED DILATION now ticks faster.
* Reduced the balance knock from hitting DISTORTION when trying to move to be in line with other room hinders.

Elementalism
------------
* DIAMONDSKIN has had its defence vs denizens slightly increased - player mitigation regains unchanged.
* Magi's PVE damage has been increased.

Formulation
-----------
* MAYOLOGY now has a 5 minute cooldown between uses. We may increase or decrease this depending after some monitoring of the situation.
* MAYOLOGY now periodically damages the user every five seconds with a message to the room indicating that the enhanced state is present.

Groves
------
* Increased WILDGROWTH to the same hinder chance as other room hinders.

Harmonics
---------
* Positive harmonics will now benefit those people that have you lusted as well as your standard allies.
* PERCUSSIA now stuns everyone in the room except the bard, rather than just the bard's personal enemies.

Metamorphosis
-------------
* DRUID PVE damage has been increased.

Puppetry
--------
* FASHION now only requires one unbroken arm.

Shikudo
-------
* HIRU no longer gives blackout if prone, it rather has a chance to give confusion.
* KURO has had its guaranteed lethargy kata requirement raised from 6 to 11.
* RUKU has had its limb damage changed to be equivalent to FRONTKICK.

Skirmishing
-----------
* SKULLBASH will no longer run into the prone burst damage cooldown when used in a solo setting.

Spirituality
------------
* ANGEL AURA now has a shorter equilibrium when used on someone other than yourself.

Striking
--------
* AIRFIST is now 100% PARRY bypass as it is already with GUARDING.
* AIRFIST shin cost raised from 15 to 20.

Terminus
--------
* BOORETH word balance significantly increased.
* BOORETH given hatred affliction duration down from 15 seconds to 10.

Vodun
-----
* FASHION now only requires one unbroken arm.

Misc
----
* Removed the ability to have multiple gems of transmutation (this includes a level 1 and a level 2, multiple level 1s, multiple level 2s, or any variation there of). People who have these should contact me for either a free upgrade to a level 2 from level 1 or a 75% trade in of their additional gem. If you've purchased an additional gem in the last six months, we'll offer a 100% tradein on said gem.
* The cooldown on CLUMSINESS has been removed.
* LUCRESCENT NUTS now last for 2 hours instead of 1.

Enjoy!

Penned by My hand on the 20th of Lupar, in the year 753 AF.

posts.subject: Classleads 2017 q4: batch 2
posts.message:
We've just loaded up the second batch of classleads for the q4 2017 round. Here are the details:

Curses
------
* Along with BLOODLET changes, INFLAME has had its formula adjusted upwards slightly (more damage per point of bleeding).

Dragoncraft
-----------
* The GARE exits to Hashan and Cyrene now lead to defendable to be in line with the exits for other cities.

Kaido
-----
* TRANSMUTE has had the 1000 health cap removed - the cap is now however much health you are missing. This change is to lower scripting burden and not intended to impact mechanical viability in any way, so the cap is still 1000 if being FORCED to TRANSMUTE.

Occultism
---------
* TENTACLES now prevents flight. This is experimental and I may revert it if it turns out to still be too potent.

Pranks
------
* BOP now scales with strength when targeted at denizens.
* When you STRAP a bomb to a mouse, the command will skip over mice that already have a bomb attached if you do not specify a numeric ID.

Shikudo
-------
* FRONTKICK now shows which side is being attacked in the various messages.

Spiritlore
----------
* BLOODLET is now a flat bleeding amount to be more in line with the mechanics of CURSES INFLAME.

Twoarts
-------
* DISCERN now has messages for every 100 bleeding threshold up to 1000. This includes all classes with access to DISCERN.

Vodun
-----
* MANGLE when used on a damaged limb by a SHAMAN will now raise the limb to mangled rather than doing nothing.

Weaponmastery
-------------
* SLAUGHTER, DOUBLEWHIRL, WHIRL, and COMBINATION attacks now all scale with strength when targeted at denizens.

Misc
----
* The STOP command can now be used while in aeon without resetting the sluggish timer.

Enjoy!

Penned by My hand on the 7th of Aeguary, in the year 754 AF.

posts.subject: Classleads 2017 q4: batch 3
posts.message:
We've just loaded up the third batch of classleads for this quarter. Here are the details:

Dragoncraft
-----------
* Expanding on previous changes, when DEVOUR enters its specialed channeled state (where it becomes much harder to stop), broken limbs and being off equilibrium will no longer interrupt it.

Necromancy
----------
* There is now a short delay between a SOULSPEAR hitting and GRAVEHANDS manifesting in the target's room.
* There is no longer any ESSENCE lost in the transfer via DRAIN, if said DRAIN is carried out either in the MHALDOR ISLE or MHALDOR CITY areas. This required some fairly major changes to how DRAIN functions, so bug any inconsistencies with old behaviour.

Physiology
----------
* EVALUATE without the partial specifier now has an internal cooldown of 1 second rather than an equilibrium cost.
* REAVE has been sped up at all three stages (most significantly at the all 4 tempers stage).
* SULPHUR based homunculi will now afflict with disrupt if their attack drains someone to under 75% of maximum mana.

Seafaring
---------
* WAR GALLIES rate of leakage is no longer set far higher than other ships. This might require further adjustments.

Traits
-----
* EXPERT DIAGNOSER now requires and consumes balance( around 2 seconds). I have enabled free trait switching for the next 24 hours so you can fix your traits if desired.

Weaponry
--------
* You can now THROW items while gripping is up.

Misc
----
* All the various forms of FEAR now cancel tumble before the valid movement checks. So for instance if you rush about in fear but are paralysed/have broken legs/etc, the tumble will now be interrupted whereas previously it would not be.
* TRAMPLE via the ARACHNIDEYE talisman now only breaks two limbs all of the time if the target is prone. Otherwise it will always break one and have a chance to break 2.

Enjoy!

Penned by My hand on the 6th of Scarlatan, in the year 754 AF.

posts.subject: Classleads 2017 q4: batch 4
posts.message:
We're pleased to bring you the next batch of classleads from the current cycle. Here are all of the details:

Aeonics
-------
* You may now CHRONO ASSERT to cleanse the LOOP effect from a scythe imbued with it. This requires but does not consume balance.

Artifice
--------
* DESTABILISE DISSONANCE now breaks prismatic barriers in addition to shields.
* SCORCH can now only be performed off balance following a STAFFSTRIKE, similar to PUMMEL.
* SMASH can now only be performed off balance following a STAFFSTRIKE, similar to PUMMEL.

Curses
------
* Reverted a previous change to JINX, reallowing the ability to stash jinx charges subject to charge-specific timers.

Dragoncraft
-----------
* BREATHGUST performed on someone in the sky or trees will now knock that person back to the ground instead of failing to do anything.

Metamorphosis
-------------
* MAUL now does more damage against denizens, and scales with strength.
* SCRATCH now does more damage against denizens, and scales with strength.

Necromancy
----------
* BELCH now respects the necromancer's personal enemies.

Occultism
---------
* ELDRITCHMISTS now respects the occultist's personal enemies.

Pranks
------
* SLIPPERINESS now provides a small amount of damage mitigation vs adventurers, though it is less than the one it grants against denizen sourced damage.

Telepathy
---------
* MIND CRUSH can now be used against denizens. Naturally, this is in room only. It is also hindered by paralysis and other such limitors, because the Sidhe court will not be so simply overcome.

Twoarts
-------
*All STANCES excluding ARASH now convey some form of damage mitigation, although much inferior to that offered by MIR.

Weaponmastery
-------------
* (Two handed): DISCIPLINE has been added to the skill.
* (Two handed): OVERWHELM added to the skill.
* (Two handed): BRAIN has had its damage formula changed. It has had its damaged increased against target's with damaged/mangled head statuses.
* (Dual cutting): RAZESLASH now only requires one arm be entirely free.

Weaponry
--------
* PARRY no longer requires you have a parrying weapon wielded to gain the defence, only at the time of actually parrying an attack.

Misc
----
* ASSESS with health inspector now has a 1 second cooldown, but can now be performed off balance/equilibrium.
* Army leaders can now claim up to THREE bounties. Army members of the FOURTH rank or higher can now claim up to TWO bounties. Everyone else can still claim up to a maximum of ONE bounty.

Enjoy!

Penned by My hand on the 8th of Ero, in the year 756 AF.

posts.subject: Classleads 2017 q4: batch 5
posts.message:
I'm pleased to bring you the next batch of classleads for this quarter. Here are the details:

Pranks
------
* BADJOKE now also drops denizen shields.
* The first tick on a person for ITCHING will now not occur for at least 2 seconds.
* The clouds made by SMOKEBOMBS will now always work regardless of how the smokebomb was detonated.

Riding
------
* If auto dismounting when tumbling due to BREAKFALL, your mount will now follow you when this occurs. This means the mount will follow you on tumble completion if you possess the ARTEFACT LEADROPE.

Runelore
--------
* It is now possible to EMPOWER CLOTH ARMOUR.

Shikudo
-------
* FRONTKICK now respects BALANCING.
* The deathsight for CRESCENT now fires correctly.
* CRESCENT against a prone target will now put you immediately into TYKONOS FORM following the attack. This occurs whether it succeeds or not.

Survival
--------
* You can now SUPPRESS REVERBERATION <direction> to suppress a reverberation vibration from adjacent. This carries the same limitations as suppressing in room (no magi present unless said room is disrupted by a cube sigil previously), and carries a slightly longer channel.

Misc
----
* You can now use syntax similar to GET [SLITH] in order to specifically get the corpse of Slith if possible. This should work for all commands that refer to corpses.
* The issue where you could only throw CUBE SIGILS adjacent by ID has been resolved. You'll now only throw at ground if specifying AT GROUND or by not specifying a target as in THROW CUBE.
* The NORTHEAST exit for ATAVIAN WINGS has been moved.
* Charging organisational enemies with crimes is now logged to said organisations logs automatically.

Enjoy!

Penned by My hand on the 18th of Chronos, in the year 756 AF.

posts.message:

Groves

Jewellery

posts.subject: Classleads for 2018 q1: batch 1
posts.message:
We're pleased to bring you the first batch of classleads from the latest round. Here are all the details:
Duress
------
* GALE now delivers MANALEECH when it successfully strips shield.

Ignition
--------
* FLAMEWHIP will now deliver PARALYSIS and SENSITIVITY if the target lacks the TEMPERANCE defence.
* FLAMEWHIP has had its willpower cost reduced when targeting denizens.
* When moving from your CRUCIBLE to an adjacent location via COMET, your crucible shall move into that new location assuming another crucible is not already present in the new location.
* The spark requirement for NOVA has been reduced from MAJOR to MODERATE.
* BRAND now has a different message when flared at its maximum possible number of stacks.
* Passing through a FIREWALL when LEAVING a room with a CRUCIBLE in it will deal 25% more damage on the firewall effect to non Fire Elementals.

Pervasion
---------
* PURIFY is now blocked by weariness.
* WRECK changed to give STUPIDITY and RECKLESSNESS from STUPIDITY and DIZZINESS.

Sculpting
--------
* TITAN has had its duration increased and cooldown reduced (up to 20 seconds and 7 minutes respectively). The relevant artefact still adds 5 seconds to the duration and knocks 3 minutes off the cooldown.
* JUGGERNAUT will now disrupt all propped totems in a location upon entering.
* CRUNCH and PULVERISE can no longer build shaping against player loyals.

posts.subject: Oppression tweaks
posts.message:
Based on some feedback, I've just loaded up some changes to Oppression:

* You can now have multiple hellforged weapons, but only one of each type. It is intended that you only use one at a time (so only get one effect per combo): this is just for more trivial switching between weapon types and specialisations. To facilitate this, only one oppression effect can fire per combo where dual wielding specs are concerned.
* To facilitate this, we needed to rework some things, particularly around inline investing. The only change that you should see is that order matters now where it did not: if your hellforged weapon is in your left hand, the effect you want on it will need to go first. Functionally it follows the same rules as envenoming, where previously it technically did not.
* APOTHEOSIS has seen some small RP and mechanical additions where the champion is concerned.
* Calling your weapon will now call all of your hellforged weapons to you.

posts.message:

posts.subject: The firelord is dead
posts.message:
A big batch of changes for you all, including the attempt to bring some sanity to the Occultist class. I expect we will still need to tweak a few things after seeing it out in the wild, but it should be much easier to adjust going forward now that all the power isn't tied up in the terror that was Pyradius. The ENDURE ability is highly experimental, so I'll be monitoring that closely and may remove it if it proves not to work as I'm hoping it will. Anyhow:

Anathema
--------
* You can no longer EXTINCTION both legs or both arms at once. You must split the limb type.

Apostasy
--------
* The cost of DEMON BECKON has been reduced (quite considerably).

Charnel
-------
* STILL now blocks more than one communication every three seconds, rather than one every four.
* STILL now blocks communication into the room from external sources, though not out of it (since this communication is still subject to the primary still effect). Little bit of an oversight in the initial implementation.

Devotion
--------
* PIETY now has a third person message when it fires (applies to hallowed as well for Excision).

Domination
----------
* FIRELORD has been repurposed. (Yes, this means no more instant firelord/enlighten frustration.)
* DISLOYALTY no longer hinders command, since this is not really viable for most classes. WEARINESS does instead.
* Nin'Kharsag's command is now gated by asthma only, not asthma and addiction.
* EERION no longer scales to insane speeds off of aff count. Its now a flat equilibrium cost and made a little faster if WHISPERINGMADNESS is on the target.
* WEAKENED MIND can no longer decide to not randomly cure itself on a focus.

Occultism
---------
* ENLIGHTEN conditions moved from 5 afflictions to 6 normally, and from 4 with whisperingmadness to 5 with whisperingmadness.
* INSTILL now does 3% hp/mana damage. This is raised to 6% if you hold a Glaaki derived truename (corpse ones do not do this).
* WHISPERINGMADNESS no longer gives a focus affliction when you focus. It is just a focus balance extender now.
* BODYWARP has been expanded significantly. See the abfile for details.
* AGUE now freezes twice if a target has more than one restoration broken limb.
* New ability: REGRESS.
* New ability: COMPEL.
* new ability: INTERLINK.
* ENLIGHTEN now credits the occultist with the kill when they die to alternative sources.

Oppression
----------
* BLOODLUST can now push you above maximum health and mana when it fires, up to a cap of 150% of your max.

Pestilence
----------
* WEARINESS no longer stops pestilence attacks against a target suffering from a prone state (entangled, paralysed, etc).

Runelore
--------
* ISAZ has had its balance knock on hindering an escape reduced. Its still a little more than other room hinders due to it being inferior in several ways, but  its less stark a difference than it was previously.

Shadowmancy
-----------
* Depthswalkers now inately see in the dark for... obvious reasons.

Spirituality
------------
* JUDGEMENT now lets you cleanse someone of enlightenment. Naturally, they still die, but the Occultist will not get credit. Judging in this way bypasses situations where you otherwise would be immune to judgement.

Subterfuge
----------
* When you EVADE from a room, all of your pinshots will be yanked loose of your happless victims.

Survival
--------
* New ability: ENDURE.

Tarot (all death tarot changes also apply to Jester's)
-----
* HIEROPHANT is now jester specific.
* HERETIC has been added to Occultist tarot.
* TYRANNY has been reworked.
* DEATH tarot now gives a layer of freeze when you RUB it on someone, though can only chill them up to shivering.
* When you RUB death, you gain an additional rub for each condition you meet from: paralysed, aeon, entangled, stunned.
* DEATH has been added to the list of more nitch instakills that bypass STARBURST.
* CREATOR can now be ruinated.

Tekura
------
* CAT stance has had its speed penalty removed.

Weaponmastery
-------------
* Switching specialisation via the artefact insignia has had its times changed. Level 1 is now 12 hours, level 2 is now 1 hour, level 3 is now 1 minute. Still respecting aggression cooldown, naturally.

Misc
----
* The TENDERSKIN now does some health damage when applying salves and not under the INQUISITION affliction.

Enjoy!

Psion is getting its own post here because there are a few things to unpack. The spoiler is that Psion is now influenced by rebounding, but there were a fair few considerations here which guided implementation:
- Avoiding players from having to collect all new lines for Psion attacks if they just want to carry on mostly as they were. As many of you know, Psion attacks have the strike built into the message.
- Making it clear what attack rebounded for people who care about that at high levels of play.
- Not impacting Psion finishers/late game.
- Making reflections not as powerful vs Psion.

To that end:
- The following Psion weapons now all hit and reflect off of aura of rebounding:
* Backhand
* Overhand
* Deathblow
* Lightsteal
* Exsanguinate
* Hamstring
* Puncture
* Sever
Note: unweaves and flurry do not rebound. This is by design. Miriads do not rebound (we could add this, but I feel this is fine to keep the ability strong as its not overperforming at all currently). Attacks that rebound do not fire the prepare (we could, but again: I feel that would be too punishing at an initial pass).

The lines for all these attacks remain unchanged, but there are new lines for each of them when they rebound. If you don't care, no new lines required here. If you do, they're there. The line for sever and hamstring is the same currently, just differentiated on the limb (arms for sever, legs for hamstring).

Additional changes:
* Cleave now strips rebounding alongside shield. It does not prone when it only strips rebounding, but does whenever a shield is stripped (whether in isolation or alongside the rebounding).
* Small cleave message change when it strips something. The miss message remains as-is.

posts.subject: Some updates.
posts.message:
There will be some larger magi changes coming, but they require a bit more refinement before I'm entirely happy with them.

Crystalism
----------
* STRIDULATING has undergone a full rework:
- The old functionality is entirely gone.
- The duration has gone up from six seconds to fifteen.
- A stridulating person now periodically has hostile vibrations from the casting magi coalesce on their person (approximately every three seconds). Some vibes are excluded from this:
* Retardation/silence: same reason mostly here, I don't want to see this used to dive groups and instant bring fundamentally game changing vibrations on top of them from an allied magi giving you stridulating.
* Portal/alarm/grounding: these don't count as hostile.
* Cataclysm: convenience, the magi almost certainly doesn't want this flying all over the place.
- It can now be cured by bellwort, though not tree. The intent here is you can cure it while running if so inclined (so vibes don't just stick to you without recourse), but it won't eat your tree or similar and make magi stacks deeper as a consequence. It is a very low priority by default in serverside, adjust based on your preference.
- Note some differences to crystalism focus: duplicate vibes are not wiped upon stridulating, they're just skipped. It can also bring reverberation currently, but I will be monitoring this closely and may change this if it proves problematic (in group contexts mostly).
- Your own stridulating will not work for you, because I know at least one of you will try.

Elementalism
------------
* Basic elemental attacks have had their damage reduced a little across the board.
* Emanations (except earth which is already about where I'd want it) have had their damage increased slightly to offset this. Essentially, the constant damage is lower but the periodic burst is higher, should be easier to work around for more fragile people.

Metamorphosis
-------------
* MAUL has been sped up slightly in PVE.

Venom
-----
* EKANELIA has had support added for consuming an affliction from the conditional list upon its firing. This is to facilitate making the big ticket hits less of a downward spiral you can't really hope to get out of once it gets going. This will all show up under EKANELIA CONSIDER, similar to bonuses.
* The CURARE ekanelia (causing hypochondria) now consumes the hypersomnia. This should make curing decisions matter more in the closing phase.

Misc
----
* Fire and ice afflictions no longer cure one another. I believe I have got all of the instances of this happening, but if you come across one which has been missed, please do message me.

Enjoy!

Penned by My hand on the 3rd of Miraman, in the year 984 AF.

This ability is nowhere near as powerful as it was in the past given the change to how it functions against a standing target, so locking it out in this manner is unnecessary. posts.subject: Some meta adjustments.
posts.message:
A general note on some of these changes: we've always been in a bit of an arms race with teamfight automation and we've definitely been losing that one lately. We'll be experimenting with a few things to see how they work out now that the Championship games are over and hopefully we'll be able to dial things back a little in that department. Some of these might prove problematic and we'll revert if so, feedback of course welcome. The goal is to make teamfights last a bit longer and to mitigate the power of the old 'alpha strike' so to speak.

Avoidance
----------
* (Admin): EPITOMISE duration increased from six seconds to nine.
* (Admin): EPITOMISE cooldown reduced from sixty seconds to fifty.
- Note: both of the above are pre light stepper modifiers.
* (Admin): EPITOMISE is now far more forgiving in terms of fire conditions. Stock hinder states now longer prevent it, as these generally meant it just never fired in most group comps.
* (Admin): New ability: METABOLISE. This is the big one, please read the abfile carefully if you're a frequent team fight participent!

Hypnosis
--------
* (Admin): The DISRUPT suggestion now only truly disrupts if they are confused. Otherwise it imposes a short eq knock.
- Note: I mostly don't want this just being baked in as a powerful hinder into already strong hypno chains, but do want to keep the locking potential available since I feel its distinctly serpent. This is a small nudge and we might need to go a little further, but we shall see.

Twoarts

* (Bug): MULTISLASH can no longer miss against prone/hindered targets.

Misc
----
* (Admin): Fog now hides gmcp and names of people entering or leaving the room.
* (Admin): Fog now blocks who here.
- Note: these two are to try to mitigate the perfect trackable information state of a given room.

Enjoy!

- On morphing to a different form, you have thirty seconds of time to summon flame again. If you do so, you'll return to your former flame level after a short delay.

-----------
* (324): EMBRACE no longer requires vines.

Subterfuge
----------
* (Admin): The snake pets sileris strip has been altered to be progressive rather than one and done. It now degrades each tick and after a certain number of hits the sileris defence is stripped. The rate of degradement is increased by darkshade being present and significantly increased by scytherus being present (if both are present, it strips instantly as previously).
* Note: my goal here was for this to facilitate the late game scytherus push but in practice it was just meaning sileris is turned off almost 100% of the time and consequently meaning frat was basically an always on thing too,. This should preserve the snakes potency for mid to late game but slow things down a little earlier on.

Enjoy!

- Notes: the attempt to slow down serpent early game while preserving the post snap explosiveness of the class continues. This change is fairly experimental but its my hope it moves the class more into what was envisioned rather than an offense that just never really drops off in a meaningful way. This one might very well get reverted though, we shall see how it pans out.
* (admin): SEAL is now unmodified equilibrium when off balance.
- See above.

Physiology
----------
* (229): Tempered MELANCHOLIC now caps passive mana regen level. Level two at two stacks, level one at four stacks, no regen at six stacks. The old penalty to moss still remains, this is in addition not a replacement.

----------
